project.name: DomainLease-Linux
project.purpose: Build a monitor-backed Linux datacenter OS in which process-through-container Domain escape requires a Domain Monitor or typed service-endpoint break comparable to hypervisor escape.

publication.scope: The superproject, project-control/models, and Linux patch-queue repositories are intentionally public; no credentials, private keys, tokens, or private operational data may be committed.

architecture_intent.threat: Attacker controls all userspace and obtains arbitrary Linux kernel-context execution inside one Domain.
architecture_intent.hard_boundary: The attacker cannot reach another Domain's private user or kernel state, execution authority, device queue, DMA memory, management authority, or Domain Monitor roots.
architecture_intent.cluster_shape: One logical OS and authority namespace with node-local enforcement; no global runqueue or synchronously shared kernel heap.
architecture_intent.linux_role: Domain-local ABI, within-Domain scheduling, policy input, and service implementation; Linux mutable state is not a production authority root.
architecture_intent.monitor_role: Domain identity/epoch, root leases and scheduling, root CPU budgets, MemoryViews/page ownership, executable sealing roots, IOMMU/queue ownership, and immutable audit roots.

accepted_invariants.text: Linux-visible pointers, tags, queue state, cgroups, capabilities, and policy decisions cannot mint Monitor authority.
No ordinary Domain execution occurs without a fresh frozen run authority tuple and a Monitor-valid root lease, epoch, CPU binding, MemoryView, and budget.
A compromised Linux scheduler cannot extend or suppress root leases or permanently starve another admitted guaranteed Domain.
Every mutable privileged page has exactly one Domain, typed service, Monitor, or explicit shared-buffer ownership class; unknown ownership is unmapped.
Every privileged entry, nested entry, and return preserves active Domain, MemoryView, epoch, stack, and translation authority.
Shared executable content is Monitor-verified, W^X, non-Domain-writable, and code-epoch consistent across views.
Domain-originated async execution carries immutable caller provenance and uses service authority intersected with caller-frozen authority.
Queue, DMA MemoryView, IRQ route, epoch, and rate/budget authority revoke as one Monitor-owned lease boundary.
Remote authority is not directly executable; signed bounded leases compile to node-local authority and fail according to explicit partition/fencing rules.
Positive promotion decisions validate only validator-captured immutable bytes and recompute summaries from retained raw evidence.

design_boundaries: Linux-only prototypes may measure integration and cost but never claim hypervisor-grade protection.
sched_ext may prototype policy but cannot be the no-run-without-authority root.
R6 64-slot state is a candidate per-CPU resident working set, not a global Domain cardinality limit.
Monitor root scheduling is minimal and policy-bounded; Linux keeps within-Domain scheduler complexity.
Process-granular Domains are supported but selected under an explicit security and complete-path cost envelope.
N-155 is historical v1 inventory/local-contract coverage, not final component composition.
No behavior-changing Linux patch is currently approved.
The exact R11 G0 v1 bundle is rejected before external review and remains an immutable negative snapshot.
The epoch-2 v2, v3, first F0 v4, and F0 v5 machine draft-1 semantic artifacts are immutable rejected snapshots; local structural checks and advisory reviews are not K0 authority.

Analysis 0219 and Validation 0308 locally close only F0 v5 canonical source static checking and immutable link construction; Eval, Reads, transition, WF, claim, proof, and external assurance remain open.
The production source path is byte-snapshot only; direct mutable-dict checker construction cannot issue wire-validation evidence, and local cross reconstruction is not external validation.
Seven issued F0 v5 construction ID kinds have machine-readable preimage and invalidation policies; future semantic IDs remain forbidden until alpha normalization and semantic context are frozen.
ADR-0020 requires F0 v5 to close normative denotation, machine grammar, proof identity, total action closure, finite batches, claim-bound nonvacuity, and extension/platform morphisms before F1.
No F1, F2, F3 completion, R11 machine IR, or TLA+ translation is authorized before an executable externally rooted epoch-2 K0 decision.

ADR-0024 fixes GPT-5.6 Sol maximum-effort architecture synthesis, hostile contradiction search, and minimality analysis as non-authoritative primary construction passes; conclusions must be materialized and mechanically checked.
TLA+ is a terminal post-freeze validation backend and may discover counterexamples but may not invent, weaken, or approve semantics.
Candidate-4 currently has only fast/static local credit: child 274, parent 715, and runner 44 hostile cases pass, while full child/parent reachability and declared commutation are not run.

Candidate-4 component receipts are captured by the candidate validator and checked for internal consistency by the outer runner; they are not authority-disjoint execution observations or externally attested evidence.

The same-UID runner does not prove runtime input immutability, escaped-descendant containment, post-finalization storage immutability, or external toolchain authentication; full promotion requires a root-owned dedicated-UID containment service.

The Candidate-4 authority-disjoint capture contract digest is 14ca4b5424f448462ff0868689f278f412ee43fe2d32d8372a8cacc78d4fd075; 153 hostile mutations, 13 derived checks, and the bounded supervisor/platform/fault/reducer mechanism suites pass, closing G1-G5 locally at EC0 while the exact full capture G6 and real-byte reduction G7 remain open.

open_questions.text: Which production Monitor root server refines the accepted cyclic-reservation reference while preserving bounded service and cost efficiency?
Which dynamic admission/rejection, recurring-request, churn/overflow, generation-rekey, and directory semantics refine the accepted finite Monitor-owned contract?
Which externally rooted policy, reviewer, and gate authorities can independently pin and accept the final F0-F3 epoch-2 K0 source set without candidate self-attestation?

Which root-owned dedicated-UID service captures Candidate-4 component execution, cgroup lifecycle, immutable inputs, toolchain identity, and final evidence without trusting candidate-validator self-report?
Which privileged entry classes execute in a Domain view versus a Monitor/service entry view?
Which management/signing compromise cases are contained, recoverable, or explicitly outside the production claim?
What maximum stale-authority lease window and clock assumptions are acceptable during partitions?
